Prices per person from 2-adult queries, max 2 stops. Google fares request one checked bag. Skyscanner/OTA fares are ranked independently of Google: the airfare column shows the raw OTA fare plus a conservative configured checked-bag estimate (hover for the breakdown). Rows marked indicative were last checked more than a day ago — re-verify via the Skyscanner link before booking. Open jaw = sum of two one-ways (verify the true multi-city price via the GF links). Times are local; (+n) = arrival n days after departure; duration includes layovers. For round trips the return leg is the actual flight paired with the shown outbound when available (fetched via Google's selection API), otherwise a reference (the best one-way on the same date, marked ≈) — verify via the GF links. Transfers are config estimates, added per person: open jaw = shinkansen; round trip = shinkansen + domestic flight; FlixBus per Vienna leg (shinkansen €90, domestic flight €65, FlixBus €15/direction). Δ vs previous run. Airport codes carry full names on hover — or click any row for a detail card.
